answer: A vault-held identity bond melting like a glacier stops cheap fakes. Each agent locks 40 tokens in a vault; the bond decays 2 tokens per epoch, and only honest work tops it up. History accrues in shale layers, one per honest epoch, and a deep shale record renews at half cost. Forging 100 identities costs 4,000 tokens plus 200 of decay per epoch while fakes earn nothing. An honest agent pays once, earns 3 tokens per epoch, and keeps its bond.
